name: 2-Br-4,5-DMPEA
summary: 6-Br-DMPEA, or 6-bromo-DMPEA, also known as 2-bromo-4,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine (2-Br-4,5-DMPEA) or as ortho-2C-B (o-2C-B), is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine family related to 3,4-dimethoxyphenethylamine (DMPEA). It is the derivative of DMPEA with a bromine atom at the 6 position.

pharmacology.text: 6-Br-DMPEA is assumed to act on serotonin receptors similarly to other psychedelics.

summaryZh: 2-溴-4,5-二甲氧基苯乙胺是一種有機化合物，化學式為C10H14BrNO2，它是2C-B的同分異構體，在一些國家（如荷蘭）合法。它可由3,4-二甲氧基苯乙胺和溴在乙酸中反應得到。
